lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਵਹੁ ਭੁਲੀ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: naavahu bhulee chotaa khaae ||
lines.translation: Wandering from the Name, he endures beatings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: bahut siaanap bharam na jaae ||
lines.translation: Even great cleverness does not dispel doubt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਚਿ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਅਚੇਤ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਅਜਗਰਿ ਭਾਰਿ ਲਦਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: pach pach mue achet na chetahi ajagar bhaar ladaaee he ||8||
lines.translation: The unconscious fool does not remain conscious of the Lord; he putrifies and rots away to death, carrying his heavy load of sin. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਬਾਦ ਬਿਰੋਧਹਿ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin baad birodhahi koee naahee ||
lines.translation: No one is free of conflict and strife.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਦੇਖਾਲਿਹੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai dekhaalihu tis saalaahee ||
lines.translation: Show me anyone who is, and I will praise him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: man tan arap milai jagajeevan har siu banat banaaee he ||9||
lines.translation: Dedicating mind and body to God, one meets the Lord, the Life of the World, and becomes just like Him. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh kee gat mit koi na paavai ||
lines.translation: No one knows the state and extent of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਵਡਾ ਕਹਾਇ ਵਡਾਈ ਖਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: je ko vadaa kahaai vadaaee khaavai ||
lines.translation: Whoever calls himself great, will be eaten by his greatness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਦਾਤੀ ਸਗਲੀ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: saache saahib tot na daatee sagalee tinahi upaaee he ||10||
lines.translation: There is no lack of gifts of our True Lord and Master. He created all. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadee vadiaaee veparavaahe ||
lines.translation: Great is the glorious greatness of the independent Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਦਾਨੁ ਸਮਾਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap upaae daan samaahe ||
lines.translation: He Himself created, and gives sustanance to all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: aap daiaal door nahee daataa miliaa sahaj rajaaee he ||11||
lines.translation: The Merciful Lord is not far away; the Great Giver spontaneously unites with Himself, by His Will. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਸੋਗੀ ਇਕਿ ਰੋਗਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik sogee ik rog viaape ||
lines.translation: Some are sad, and some are afflicted with disease.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo kichh kare s aape aape ||
lines.translation: Whatever God does, He does by Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਉ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਅਨਹਦਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਖਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat bhaau gur kee mat pooree anahad sabad lakhaaee he ||12||
lines.translation: Through loving devotion, and the Perfect Teachings of the Guru, the unstruck sound current of the Shabad is realized. ||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਨਾਗੇ ਭੂਖੇ ਭਵਹਿ ਭਵਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik naage bhookhe bhavahi bhavaae ||
lines.translation: Some wander and roam around, hungry and naked.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਹਠੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਨ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik hath kar marahi na keemat paae ||
lines.translation: Some act in stubbornness and die, but do not know the value of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਤਿ ਅਵਿਗਤ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: gat avigat kee saar na jaanai boojhai sabad kamaaee he ||13||
lines.translation: They do not know the difference between good and bad; this is understood only through the practice of the Word of the Shabad. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵਹਿ ਅੰਨੁ ਨ ਖਾਵਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik teerath naavahi a(n)n na khaavahi ||
lines.translation: Some bathe at sacred shrines and refuse to eat.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਲਾਵਹਿ ਦੇਹ ਖਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik agan jalaavahi deh khapaavahi ||
lines.translation: Some torment their bodies in burning fire.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam bin mukat na hoee kit bidh paar la(n)ghaaee he ||14||
lines.translation: Without the Lord's Name, liberation is not obtained; how can anyone cross over? ||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਛੋਡਹਿ ਉਝੜਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramat chhodahi ujhaR jaaee ||
lines.translation: Abandoning the Guru's Teachings, some wander in the wilderness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਪੈ ਅਵਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh raam na japai avaaee ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are destitute; they do not meditate on the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਚਿ ਪਚਿ ਬੂਡਹਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਕੂੜਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਬੈਰਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: pach pach boodahi kooR kamaavahi kooR kaal bairaaee he ||15||
lines.translation: They are ruined, destroyed and drowned from practicing falsehood; death is the enemy of the false. ||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਆਵੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: hukame aavai hukame jaavai ||
lines.translation: By the Hukam of the Lord's Command, they come, and by the Hukam of His Command, they go.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੂਝੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸੋ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: boojhai hukam so saach samaavai ||
lines.translation: One who realizes His Hukam, merges in the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak saach milai man bhaavai guramukh kaar kamaaee he ||16||5||
lines.translation: O Nanak, he merges in the True Lord, and his mind is pleased with the Lord. The Gurmukhs do His work. ||16||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape karataa purakh bidhaataa ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the Creator Lord, the Architect of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin aape aap upaai pachhaataa ||
lines.translation: He evaluates those whom He Himself has created.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aape satigur aape sevak aape srisat upaaee he ||1||
lines.translation: He Himself is the True Guru, and He Himself is the servant; He Himself created the Universe. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਨੇੜੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੂਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape neRai naahee doore ||
lines.translation: He is near at hand, not far away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੂਝਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: boojhahi guramukh se jan poore ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs understand Him; perfect are those humble beings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਏਹ ਵਡਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tin kee sa(n)gat ahinis laahaa gur sa(n)gat eh vadaaee he ||2||
lines.translation: Associating with them night and day is profitable. This is the glorious greatness of associating with the Guru. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਸੰਤ ਭਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jug jug sa(n)t bhale prabh tere ||
lines.translation: Throughout the ages, Your Saints are holy and sublime, O God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸੇਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har gun gaavahi rasan rasere ||
lines.translation: They sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, savoring it with their tongues.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਜਿਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਿੰਤ ਪਰਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: usatat karahi parahar dukh daalad jin naahee chi(n)t paraaee he ||3||
lines.translation: They chant His Praises, and their pain and poverty are taken away; they are not afraid of anyone else. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਜਾਗਤ ਰਹਹਿ ਨ ਸੂਤੇ ਦੀਸਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: oi jaagat rahahi na soote deesahi ||
lines.translation: They remain awake and aware, and do not appear to sleep.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਰੀਸਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)gat kul taare saach pareesahi ||
lines.translation: They serve up Truth, and so save their companions and relatives.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਮਲ ਮੈਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਓਇ ਰਹਹਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: kalimal mail naahee te niramal oi rahahi bhagat liv laaee he ||4||
lines.translation: They are not stained with the filth of sins; they are immaculate and pure, and remain absorbed in loving devotional worship. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੂਝਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: boojhahu har jan satigur baanee ||
lines.translation: O humble servants of the Lord, understand the Word of the Guru's Bani.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਸਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਦੇਹ ਪੁਰਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ehu joban saas hai deh puraanee ||
lines.translation: This youth, breath and body shall pass away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਜੁ ਕਾਲਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਧਿਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: aaj kaal mar jaaeeai praanee har jap jap ridai dhiaaee he ||5||
lines.translation: O mortal, you shall die today or tomorrow; chant, and meditate on the Lord within your heart. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਕੂੜ ਕਬਾੜਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: chhodahu praanee kooR kabaaRaa ||
lines.translation: O mortal, abandon falsehood and your worthless ways.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਕਾਲੁ ਉਛਾਹਾੜਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kooR maare kaal uchhaahaaRaa ||
lines.translation: Death viciously kills the false beings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਕੂੜਿ ਪਚਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਹੁ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਚੈ ਪਚਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: saakat kooR pachahi man haumai duhu maarag pachai pachaaee he ||6||
lines.translation: The faithless cynic is ruined through falsehood and his egotistical mind.On the path of duality, he rots away and decomposes. ||6||
